cohort: All singleton deliveries occurring between 1991-2014 at Soroka University Medical Center (243,313 deliveries, including 369 from mothers with congenital heart disease).
finding: Maternal congenital heart disease was an independent risk factor for low birth weight and cesarean delivery, but no significant increase in long-term cardiovascular morbidity was found among offspring.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery rates were higher in mothers with congenital heart disease.
